statement: Stockton Street Dogs' founder estimated 200–400 dogs on Stockton's streets in April 2026.
limitations: Stockton Street Dogs founder Jesse Mejia's April 2026 estimate, ranging from at least 200–300 at any given time to as many as 400 during puppy season; not independently verified or a census.

statement: Stockton Street Dogs reported encountering 3–10 dumped dogs per week in September 2026.
limitations: Stockton Street Dogs' September 2026 account, compared with approximately one per week a year earlier; not an independently verified count.

statement: No verified current count of dogs on Stockton's streets has been established.
limitations: No verified current citywide census has been established.
